title: Room Hire, Staging and Peak Date Tariff for Private Event & Banquet Services
content:
Room hire and the charges that go with dressing a room are tariffed by package across Private Event & Banquet Services. Every figure below is the one printed against the package the booking's agreement is written against.

## Tariff

| Package | Standard room rental, USD per event | Food and beverage spend at or above which room rental is waived, USD | Peak date surcharge, per cent | Standard audio-visual package, USD | Dance floor charge, USD | Room held for set-up, hours | Room clearing window, hours |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| Meeting Room Refreshment Package | 0 | 0 | 0 | 0 | 0 | 0.5 | 0.5 |
| Boardroom Reception Package | 175 | 1500 | 5 | 125 | 0 | 1.0 | 1.0 |
| Conference Day Delegate Package | 450 | 5000 | 10 | 450 | 0 | 2.0 | 1.5 |
| Seated Banquet Package | 950 | 12000 | 15 | 850 | 650 | 4.0 | 2.0 |
| Gala Reception Package | 2200 | 28000 | 20 | 2400 | 1200 | 6.0 | 3.0 |
| Multi-Day Conference Residency Package | 5800 | 75000 | 12 | 4800 | 1500 | 8.0 | 4.0 |

The room rental column is the standard room rental charged for the package for one event, and the waiver column is the food and beverage spend at or above which that rental is waived. The peak date surcharge is the surcharge carried by events on declared peak dates, as a percentage. The audio-visual column is the standard audio-visual package for the event and the dance floor column is the charge for laying a dance floor. The last two columns are the hours before the event for which the room is held for set-up and the hours after it allowed for clearing the room.

## Notes on the tariff

Two packages carry no dance floor charge at all, the Meeting Room Refreshment Package and the Boardroom Reception Package standing at 0, as does the Conference Day Delegate Package; the charge first appears at 650 on the Seated Banquet Package.

The Meeting Room Refreshment Package stands at 0 in the room rental, waiver, surcharge, audio-visual and dance floor columns alike, so the only figures that move on that package are the half-hour set-up and the half-hour clearing window.

The highest peak date surcharge on the tariff is 20 per cent, on the Gala Reception Package, and the Multi-Day Conference Residency Package sits below it at 12 per cent notwithstanding its larger rooms.
